description: The bar chart illustrates the retrieval performance, measured as MAP@10, for two sampling strategies — “Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy” (purple bars) and “Uniform Sampling Strategy” (yellow bars) — across five values of the parameter m (6, 7, 8, 9, and 10). The vertical axis represents MAP@10, ranging from 23.0 to 27.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals, while the horizontal axis shows the discrete values of m. For each m, two adjacent bars represent the respective sampling strategies. The Fine-to-Coarse strategy consistently achieves higher MAP@10 scores, ranging from approximately 25.95 (at m=6) to 26.8 (at m=7), peaking at m=7 and showing a slight decline afterward. In contrast, the Uniform strategy scores lower, ranging from about 24.4 (at m=6) to 25.6 (at m=8), with its highest performance also at m=8. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner identifying the color coding for each strategy, and the bars are grouped by m value with no overlap, allowing for direct visual comparison. The background features light gray gridlines to aid in reading the values. Overall, the Fine-to-Coarse strategy outperforms the Uniform strategy across all tested values of m.
